== Ingredients ==
* 1 [[Cookbook:Each|ea]]. 4-bone standing [[Cookbook:Beef|beef]] rib roast
* [[Cookbook:Prime Rib Seasoning|Prime Rib Seasoning]]
* [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|Olive oil]]

== Procedure ==
#[[Cookbook:Brush|Brush]] roast with olive oil. Season all sides liberally with the prime rib seasoning.
#Place roast on a medium [[Cookbook:Grill|grill]]. Cook, turning often, until internal temperature reaches 135°F for medium rare, 145°F for medium, and 160°F for well/toast.
#Remove and cover with [[Cookbook:Aluminium Foil|aluminum foil]]. Let rest 10 minutes before serving.
